To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the development of innovative technologies and the use of secondary raw materials in the winemaking industry will contribute to solving a number of global problems: the rational use of natural resources, the creation of new products with high consumer value and high added value, the development of domestic equipment, the reduction of environmental pollution and waste generation, and the development of the national economy.

in Ukraine, the production of secondary raw materials in the winemaking industry is growing, but their processing is not effective, which leads to environmental problems and loss of material and energy resources.

in the conditions of the wine-growing regions of Ukraine, there is a significant amount of secondary raw materials (combs and grape pomace) that can be used as a raw material base for the production of various products.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the need to create a mechanism for the effective use of secondary raw materials, including grape pomace, which will allow the use of the latter in the production of a number of products with high consumer properties and the creation of clusters for the development of innovative technologies.

the following: the need for complex processing of winemaking secondary raw materials in order to obtain valuable products; the need to develop and introduce innovative technologies for processing secondary materials of winemakers; the need to create a cluster for the development and introduction of technologies for processing secondary winemaking raw materials.
the need to create an integrated system of processing secondary raw material of winemaking in Ukraine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the processing of secondary raw material of winemaking is a promising and promising area of research, which requires the creation of a cluster of enterprises and institutions for the development and introduction of innovative technologies and the use of modern equipment for the processing of grape pomace.
the development of innovative technologies for the processing of secondary raw material of winemaking is an actual scientific and technical task.

there is a need for the development and introduction of innovative technologies and the creation of clusters for processing secondary raw material of winemaking, which will allow the rational use of material resources, increase the competitiveness of the wine industry and the economy of the country, improve the environmental situation in the wine regions of Ukraine.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the development of a cluster of innovative technologies and the creation of an effective mechanism of interaction between the subjects of the cluster will contribute to the creation of a new product, which is the processed secondary raw materials of the wine-making industry, which will increase its consumer value and competitiveness.

in order to increase the efficiency of the use of secondary raw materials, it is necessary to carry out a comprehensive study of their physical, chemical, microbiological and toxicological composition, to create innovative technologies for processing them, as well as to organize their processing at specialized enterprises.

the secondary raw materials of the wine-making industry have a high potential for processing, which allows us to consider them as an important raw material for obtaining biologically active substances.
The main takeaway from our work is that

in Ukraine, there are no specialized production facilities for complex processing of waste of winemaking, traditional technologies are not efficient, both from technological, and from economic point of view.

the use of innovative technologies and technologies in the field of secondary raw materials processing will allow to increase the competitiveness of the domestic economy, create a new market for the sale of products from secondary materials, reduce the cost of raw materials for the production of food products, and increase the quality and safety of food.

it is necessary to create a mechanism for the joint development, implementation and commercialization of new products and technologies for processing secondary winemaking raw materials, which will unite the interests not only of winemaking enterprises (producers), but also of processing enterprises, scientists, and consumers of innovative products and technologies.
